paper_title: Search for axion-like particles through nuclear Primakoff production using the GlueX detector
coupling_convention: 1/Lambda = g_agamma in GeV^-1, from L = (1/4Lambda) a F Ftilde
notes: First GlueX nuclear Primakoff ALP search on 12C, mass region 200-450 MeV via a->gamma gamma. Y-axis is 1/Lambda (=g_agamma) in GeV^-1, scale O(1 TeV) i.e. ~1e-3 GeV^-1. Data points read approximately from Fig 7/8 observed (full-data) 95% CL curve; the strong dip near 360 MeV is a background fluctuation. Background-subtracted limits are somewhat weaker (~2-3e-3). Values are collider/fixed-target production bounds, not a DM haloscope, so no DM density.
